name: LookAgain-ML
description: A PyTorch-based library for extracting, comparing, selecting, and combining pretrained image representations, with group-aware validation, repeated-split stability, paired uncertainty, caching, and image quality-control workflows.

paper.citation: Nordstrom, Morgan, Ardyn Nordstrom, Matthew D. Webb, and Vamuyan Sesay. 2026. 'Representation Risk in Pretrained Image Encoders.' arXiv:2609.35470. Submitted.

cite: Please credit the software creator and cite 'Representation Risk in Pretrained Image Encoders' (arXiv:2609.35470) when the software contributes to published research.

implementations.name: lookagain-ml
implementations.install:
git clone https://github.com/vamusesay/LookAgain-ML.git
cd LookAgain-ML
python -m pip install .

name: summclust
description: Cluster-level leverage and influence diagnostics and cluster-jackknife variance estimation for linear regression models.

paper.citation: MacKinnon, James G., Morten Ørregaard Nielsen, and Matthew D. Webb. 2023. 'Leverage, Influence, and the Jackknife in Clustered Regression Models: Reliable Inference Using summclust.' Stata Journal 23(4): 942-982.

cite: Please cite the associated Stata Journal article when the method or software contributes to published research.

name: logitjack
description: Cluster-jackknife and wild-cluster-bootstrap inference for logistic regression models.

paper.citation: MacKinnon, James G., Morten Ørregaard Nielsen, and Matthew D. Webb. 'Cluster-Robust Jackknife and Bootstrap Inference for Binary Response Models.' Forthcoming, Econometric Reviews.

cite: Please cite the associated Econometric Reviews article; the SSC record also provides a software citation.

name: twowayjack
description: Jackknife variance estimation and inference for linear regression models with two-way clustering.

paper.citation: MacKinnon, James G., Morten Ørregaard Nielsen, and Matthew D. Webb. 2024. 'Jackknife Inference with Two-Way Clustering.' arXiv:2406.08880.

cite: Please cite the associated paper when using the method or implementation.

name: mnwsvt
description: Score-variance tests for choosing the appropriate level of clustering in linear regression models.

paper.citation: MacKinnon, James G., Morten Ørregaard Nielsen, and Matthew D. Webb. 2023. 'Testing for the Appropriate Level of Clustering in Linear Regression Models.' Journal of Econometrics 235: 2027-2056.

cite: Please cite the associated Journal of Econometrics article.

name: CSDID cluster-jackknife inference
description: Cluster-jackknife (CV3) inference for the Callaway-Sant'Anna difference-in-differences estimator.

paper.citation: Karim, Sunny R., Morten Ørregaard Nielsen, James G. MacKinnon, and Matthew D. Webb. 2026. 'Improved Inference for CSDID Using the Cluster Jackknife.' arXiv:2602.12043.

cite: Please cite the associated paper when using the method or software.

name: DID-INT
description: Intersection Difference-in-Differences estimation for settings in which covariate effects may vary across states, time, or both.

paper.citation: Karim, Sunny, and Matthew D. Webb. 2024. 'Good Controls Gone Bad: Difference-in-Differences with Covariates.' arXiv:2412.14447.

cite: Please cite the associated paper when using the method or software.

name: UN-DID
description: Difference-in-differences for data held in separate silos that cannot be pooled, with implementations for four programming languages.

paper.citation: Karim, Sunny, Nichole Austin, Erin Strumpf, and Matthew D. Webb. 2025. 'Difference-in-Differences with Unpoolable Data.' arXiv:2403.15910.

cite: Please cite the associated paper when using the method or software.
